test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

WASP - WPSA - PSAW

GUTS - GSTU - STUG
solution:
The logic followed here is:

WASP - WPSA - PSAW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5c5a6f405f625514e41a2dcf00953007e695cdbfa46b52cfea3c9d2cf15b3cf.png] 

GUTS - GSTU - STUG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eef9ddb9fe3bd58cea9a09ce8570741391078c0ac33316985d30a654e1d21221.png] 

 

Let's check each option:

1. HUGE - UHGE - EUGH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/948f0c2da05882081f15abe6d00f08d0712513e90bb0b06370eccc958d9a910d.png] 

This triad does not follow the same logic.

2. NICE - NECI - ECIN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be8d0875409a34c84933e0629184e3d198ca38d9fa6fbee11cf6972c1805d10d.png] 

This triad follows the same logic.

3. POND - PNOD - DNOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55260eaaebc4a11b0b5a5bf07e7169243f2745b68554bb5663fe324bb2e8dea3.png] 

This triad does not follow the same logic.

4. GROW - GRWO - ROWG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23401e7cc426e44c3dbdfd72ff44c16bf47629043cab8cf11c795777c604af72.png] 

This triad does not follow the same logic.

Thus, NICE - NECI - ECIN from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
